title: Customer Contact
description: Persisted contact channels for the authenticated customer.

emails.description: Email addresses on the customer profile.

type.description: Intended use of this address. Well-known values: `personal`, `work`. Unknown values MUST be tolerated.

preferred.description: True when this is the customer's preferred email.

phones.description: Phone numbers on the customer profile.

phone_number.description: E.164 standard. Phone number of the customer.

type.description: Intended use of this number. Well-known values: `mobile`, `home`, `work`, `fax`. Unknown values MUST be tolerated.

preferred.description: True when this is the customer's preferred phone.

addresses.description: Postal addresses on the customer profile.

type.description: Intended use of this address. Well-known values: `home`, `work`. Unknown values MUST be tolerated.

preferred.description: True when this is the customer's preferred postal address.
